diagnosis.observed: R2 holder reported ready, but R2 probe subsequently acquired the same MQL5 FILE_COMMON fence.
diagnosis.source_design_issue: The holder itself runs inside Strategy Tester. Its fence handle exists only while that tester process/run remains alive. Strategy Tester may complete the historical test and invoke OnDeinit, which releases the fence, before the separately launched probe attempts acquisition. Therefore HOLDER_READY alone does not prove real process overlap at probe time.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: The failure archive contains no durable holder-alive-at-probe marker proving simultaneous ownership. The result cannot be interpreted as a defect in Candidate3 AcquireInstanceFence semantics.
diagnosis.required_fix: R2 fencing must be moved out of accelerated Strategy Tester lifecycle. Use two isolated portable terminal processes with an attached no-trading EA/service, or an equivalent native process-overlap harness that proves holder PID/process alive, exact FILE_COMMON lock ownership, probe denial, release, and reacquire. The corrected R2 must remain Candidate3-free and order-free.

next_action: Build and qualify R2 v2 with non-accelerated native fencing before any Candidate3 Phase-A execution.
